notes: Full monorepo build (shared -> server -> client, tsc -b + vite build) is green with zero TypeScript errors. Every design.md requirement and all five MEDIUM + three NIT design-review findings are satisfied, verified by reading every server and client source file.
verified: env/secrets: env.ts appends DB_NAME/JWT_SECRET/ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD only when missing (process.env + raw-file non-comment detection), logs key names only, uses MONGODB_URI verbatim (no re-strip/interpolation), fails fast on missing MONGODB_URI/JWT_SECRET. No secret VALUES in README.md or any ts/tsx/md/json source (grep clean); .gitignore excludes *.env.
generic stripMongoId<T extends {_id?:ObjectId}>({_id,...rest}): Omit<T,'_id'> in db.ts, used across league assembly and all GET/write responses.

results validation accepts the seed shape exactly: week positive int, lanes/homeTeamId/awayTeamId non-empty strings, homeGames/awayGames arrays of numbers>=0 that MAY be empty and MAY differ in length, homeSeries/awaySeries/homePoints/awayPoints numbers>=0 with NO sum constraint (awaySeries:0 and single-element awayGames pass). PUT by _id hex (400 on bad hex), _id stripped from $set.

whitelist discipline + identity-immutability on every write: teams/bowlers strip id/_id, schedule strips week/_id, results strips _id, leagueMeta constructs the 4-field replacement doc; POST uniqueness pre-checks -> 409; no raw-body spread anywhere.

leaderboards GET (both /api/league assembly and /api/leaderboards) has NO .sort(); PUT is deleteMany+ordered insertMany preserving insertion order; value accepts number|string; seed keeps two 'High Average' boards Male then Female.

reports: multer-first chain [requireAuth, upload.single('file'), handler]; explicit 8-field toWeeklyReport mapper (never stripMongoId, no gridFsFileId leak); GridFS orphan cleanup on metadata-insert failure; GET list sorted {season,week}; GET/:id streams inline; DELETE idempotent 204. Global error handler maps MulterError LIMIT_FILE_SIZE->413, LIMIT_UNEXPECTED_FILE->400, else 400.

client: @bowling/shared adopted; vite /api proxy -> http://localhost:4000 changeOrigin:true (additive); LeagueProvider/useLeague with O(1) maps; AuthContext stores bowling-league.token, restores via fetchMe, clears token ONLY on 401/403 (keeps on network/5xx), unconditionally removes legacy bowling-league.auth, internal loading flag; main.tsx nests AuthProvider>LeagueProvider>App.

six pages + Layout migrated to useLeague(); guard order loading->CircularProgress, error->Alert, !league->null precedes data access everywhere; TeamDetailPage guards run BEFORE the team lookup and !team return; Layout silently degrades with ?? '' and adds the Reports nav item.

getReportUrl returns relative /api/reports/:id; /reports registered as a child of the <Route element={<Layout/>}> layout route; client/src/types.ts and client/src/data/league.ts deleted with zero straggler imports (grep clean).
